Bulletproof Seafarer

Toolbox Terms of Service

Development draft for review · 10 November 2026

These terms describe how you may use Toolbox, the seafarer study and document organizer offered by Bulletproof Seafarer.

Using Toolbox

You may use Toolbox for your own study and voyage preparation. Only add material you own or have permission to use. You retain your rights to the records and photos you add. Respect other people’s privacy and the rights of those who provide study materials.

Study and voyage preparation

Review questions and mock scores are practice aids. Verify answers, certificate requirements and expiry dates with the issuing authority. For duties aboard ship, follow your vessel’s approved procedures. Keep the original documents required for travel and service.

Documents on your device

The current test build keeps your document records on your device. Use sample documents during testing. Clearing app storage, uninstalling Toolbox or losing your phone can remove your only copy. Keep a separate copy of records you need.

Purchases and Bulletproof Cloud

The Google Play listing shows the applicable app price before purchase. The offline app and optional Cloud services are separate purchases. In the current test build, Cloud plans are previews. Selecting a plan does not activate billing, sync your records or back up your documents. Free tester access carries no commitment to subscribe.

Support and consumer rights

For help with a Toolbox purchase, use the developer contact shown on its Google Play listing. For a refund, you may also use Google Play’s refund request process. These terms preserve your rights and remedies under applicable consumer law.
